newsitem.title: USA: US crudes end strong on fundamentals, grades even.
newsitem.headline: US crudes end strong on fundamentals, grades even.

text.p: U.S. crudes finished the short week on a firm note, posting gains on the back of fundamental bullishness generated by weekly inventory data.
In a typically quiet session two days after the Christmas holiday, the main event was morning buying on bullish American Petroleum Institute (API) data.
Distillate stocks showed a draw of 1.89 million barrels, against expectations for a build. U.S. government statistics also were bullish, cementing the uptrend for the session.
Outrights settled 30 cts higher at $25.20-30 a barrel for Feb West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, steady from the morning.
